title: CIRCULAR MODULAR BENCH & DISPLAY SYSTEM
subtitle: An adaptable radial seating and retail exhibition architecture engineered in perforated aluminum and monolithic acrylic fins.
dimension: Ø 7,200 mm Outer Ring / 450 mm Height
description: Conceived as a dialogue between industrial precision and geological weight, the Circular Modular System is organized into twelve interconnecting arc benches that form a 360-degree perimeter within the central showroom.

Each arc segment balances on high-clarity cast acrylic vertical fins, allowing the perforated aluminum plates to float above the warm terracotta concrete plane. At the center of the ring, raw granite boulders act as an anchoring datum.

columns.caption: Fig. 01.0 — Perimeter segment installed at Werks Galleria showroom. Monolithic acrylic fins cast refracted shadows across the terracotta concrete slab.
Fig. 02.1 — Detail of 35mm clear PMMA blade coupled with twin M12 stainless fastening pins and chamfered aluminum extrusion edge.
Fig. 02.2 — Continuous curvature established through sequential segment interlocking.
Fig. 03.1 — Suspended vertical exhibition armature and modular specimen displays.
